description: Asset Master Data Governance App — Fixed Asset monitoring, approval workflow, and S/4HANA write-back

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.viewer
scopes.description: View flagged assets, scan runs, audit log

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.approver
scopes.description: Approve or reject recommendations and execute S/4HANA write-back

role-templates.name: AssetViewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access — can view flagged assets, scan results, and audit log

role-templates.name: AssetAccountant
role-templates.description: Asset Accountant — can view and submit recommendations on flagged assets

role-templates.name: FinanceManager
role-templates.description: Finance Manager — can approve/reject recommendations and execute S/4HANA write-back
